items.text: inse y’endamwamu y’Omonene ere buna enyimbo.
Ekeene, nigo akona‐koonchora okoboko kwaye igoro yane,
Otigire chinyama chi’omobere one, ne risankwa, bigosareka;
Nonya nkorera neriogi rinene ng’a nkonywe,
Nigo amboerete buna edubu, enyang’au entindi, ekoboera,
Oonchoranire chinchera chiane na kombutorana ebing’ese,
Inche nabeire oyo ogosekererwa nabaanto bane bonsi,
na engeero y’ogochaaya kwabo omobaso boira.
Obunire amaino aane ase ogontakunia chinche chi’amagena,
Aye kwarusirie omorembe ase omoyo one,
na ogosemeria kwane ase Omonene boigo.”
Inyora emechando yane, na obokong’u bwane,
Korende amang’ana aya nigo nkoyainyora ase omoyo one,
Nobwanchani bw’Omonene botari koera ng’a titosiriri,
nigo bire ebiyia ase kera emambia,
ee, obwegenwa bwao nigo bore obonene.
Omonene nere egetari kiane, ayio naro omoyo one ontebirie,
Omonene nigo are omuya ase onde bwensi omoganyete,
Nigo ere buya ase omonto okoba n’obotoereru
na koganya ogotooreka gokorwa ase Omonene.
Nigo ere buya ase omonto okobogoria rikorogoto ekero are omoke.
ekiagera Omonene nere omotwekire egurube eyio.
Tiga abeete omonwa oye ase riroba akire‐kiri,
Tiga aonchore orosea rwaye gochia ase oyio okomoaka,
Omonene tagotuguta omonto goika kare na kare.
Nonya omobekire ase omoichano, namororere amaabera naende,
Ere tari gwancha gochanda Mwanyabaanto, gose kobaichania.
gose koonchorana oboronge bw’omonto ase obosio bw’Oyore Igoro Mono,
gose gokorekania ekiina ki’omonto onde bwensi.
Ning’o okwanete ring’ana, na rirorio rigakoreka,
tari korwa ase omonwa bw’Oyore Igoro Mono?
Nase ki rende Mwanyabaanto ore moyo akwemurunganeria?
Nase ki akwemurungania ekero akonyora egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaye.
Tiga twetuke intwe abanyene na toteeme chinchera chiaito,
Tiga toimokererie chinkoro chiaito igoro, na amaboko aito,
gochia ase Nyasae ore igoro, totebe:
Aye gwatokorire twabeire eubi na abaangire,
“Ababisa baito bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gotosekerera.
Obwoba ne chiirima biatocheire amo nogosaria na ogosirigwa.
Amaiso aane nigo agoitera amariga amange buna amaache a rooche,
ase engencho y’ogosirigwa kw’omochie bw’abaanto bane.
“Amaiso aane abeire agoitera amariga atari gokama,
goika ekero Omonene ararigererie korwa igoro na arore ayio onsi.
Amaiso aane agerire nabeire nomoichano ase omoyo one
ase engencho y’abaiseke bonsi b’omochie one.
nabwo baarenge ababisa bane engencho ende etaiyo.
Bakanduta ase engoro ime inde moyo,
Amaache agaichora agaeta ase omotwe one igoro,
toticha amato ao ase ogwechanda kwane ekero nkorera.
Aye nigo kwang’igete ang’e ase rituko riria narerete asore,
Aye kwarorire buna ababisa bane baganetie korusia egesiomba,
na buna bakorire emeroberio emebe ase ’nde.
na emeroberio yabo yonsi igoro yane.
nigo bare mamincha yane omobaso boira.
Rora, ekero abwo baikaransete, na ekero bakoimoka,
Aye Omonene, babwatie nendamwamu yao, obasirie,
